newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa 97 maize acreage up to 3.361 mln hectares.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa 97 maize acreage up to 3.361 mln hectares.

text.p: South Africa's total maize acreage planted for the 1997 season, which starts on May 1, was 3.361 million hectares, up from 3.307 million in the 1996 season, the National Crop Estimates Committee said on Friday.

The committee said total white maize acreage for the new season was 1.794 million hectares, down from 1.904 million last year. Total yellow maize acreage came in at 1.567 million hectares, up from 1.403 million in 1996.
The first official maize production estimate for the 1997 season will be released around March 20, the committee said.

South Africa's commercial maize crop last year amounted to a bumper 9.48 million tonnes, but fears abound that the new crop will fall well below the nine million tonne level due to continued dry and hot weather conditions.
